summary: Iter 51 - jadwal_antar + carry-over feature. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed covering create/update transaction, PUT /deliveries/{id}/schedule, carry-over logic (previous-month unfinished appearing in current month with dari_bulan_lalu=true), and jadwal_antar matching month filter. Frontend: Pengantaran shows jadwal date input per unfinished card, Terjadwal/Dari-bulan-lalu/Terlambat/Antar-hari-ini badges render correctly, summary line shows carry-over wording when applicable, totalOngkir excludes carry-over rows. POS shows pos-jadwal-antar date input only when alamat or ongkir>0, hides when both cleared.
critical_code_review_comments: list_deliveries carry-over OR clause includes created_at<prefix for unfinished regardless of jadwal_antar; this means a future-scheduled unfinished order from an earlier month is also surfaced in the current month view labelled dari_bulan_lalu=true - likely desired given spec but worth confirming when both filter month and jadwal month differ.
server.py file size is 2444 lines - splitting by resource (transactions, deliveries, reports) would help maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixture creates TEST_ transactions and cleans them up via DELETE /api/transactions/{id}. One carry-over test backdates created_at directly in Mongo and resets by delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: POS route is /pos (not /kasir). Use get_by_text('Kasir Penjualan') from side nav. For deliveries carry-over tests, mutate created_at via Mongo using ObjectId since id is the Mongo _id string. CartItem requires name and harga fields in payload (not just product_id/qty).
